notes: Bounded source audit for D06 Moon/Mars regolith evidence. No raw rasters or PDFs are committed; only source URLs and SHA-256 checksums.
Primary values are published PDS/literature records with explicit version, licence, footprint, depth support and QA.
Secondary compilation (Gasteiner et al.) is used only as a cross-check, never as the sole source of a detected value.

datasets.license: NASA public domain report; PDS public archive copy
datasets.native_resolution: site/sample table; not a raster grid
datasets.footprint: Apollo 15 Station 8 / ALSEP area, Hadley-Apennine, Moon
datasets.depth_support: Table 7-IV estimates for the upper 10-20 cm; trench exposure ~36-41 cm
datasets.qa: Official NASA report; PDS-scanned copy SHA-256 recorded. A text-layer OCR copy is used for reading and cross-checked against the Gasteiner CSV.
datasets.notes: Table 7-IV gives SRP-derived density 1.97 g/cm3 (1.92-2.01), porosity 36.5% (35-38%), friction angle 49.5 deg (47.5-51.5) for Station 8. The summary states ~1 kN/m2 cohesion for the Station 8 soil. Values are estimates/derivations, not direct mass/volume measurements.

datasets.provider: Gasteiner et al., Lunar Regolith Database
datasets.title: An Open Database of Lunar Regolith and Simulants Properties
datasets.native_resolution: curated per-record table; not a raster grid
datasets.footprint: Multiple lunar missions/sites, including Apollo 15 Station 8
datasets.depth_support: Per-record depth column; Apollo 15 penetrometer row 0-20 cm
datasets.qa: Peer-reviewed compilation with per-record source, year and DOI/URL; used only as a cross-check in this pass
datasets.notes: Row 100 (Apollo 15 penetrometer) matches PSR Table 7-IV: density 1.97 g/cm3, friction 47.5-51.5 deg, porosity 35-38%, depth 0-20 cm. Row 101 (trench experiment) records 0.94 kPa cohesion; the PSR summary rounds this to ~1 kN/m2. Simulants are not mixed into the ingested values.

datasets.product_id: Delage et al. (2024), Investigating the Martian soil at the InSight landing site
datasets.title: Investigating the Martian soil at the InSight landing site
datasets.native_resolution: lander-site in-situ experiments and derived profiles; not a raster grid
datasets.footprint: InSight lander/HP3 site, Elysium Planitia, Mars (4.502 N, 135.623 E)
datasets.depth_support: Top ~40 cm for density; 0-7 cm mole-pit depth for scoop-push cohesion; 5.3 MPa penetration resistance in sand/gravel below ~31 cm
datasets.qa: Peer-reviewed open-access synthesis with cited HP3/SEIS/IDA measurements, stated assumptions and uncertainties
datasets.notes: Section 5.2.2 reports average density of the top 40 cm = 1491 +121/-113 kg/m3 from thermal-conductivity inversion; explicitly no direct density measurement. Section 5.2.3 reports minimum cohesion c' = 5.8 kPa (tip push) and 0.4 kPa (flat push), with friction angle fixed at 30 deg. Penetration resistance is not bearing strength.

datasets.depth_support: Upper few centimetres; no single fixed depth interval
datasets.temporal_support: Apparent thermal inertia treated as time-independent; no per-pixel acquisition time

datasets.notes: D03 thermal inertia is not converted to D06 bulk density. D06 semantics forbids thermal inertia -> density without a verified physical model and stated conductivity/heat-capacity assumptions.
